title: 第14章 梦入

content_zh:
这时我爸妈感觉到，突然自老头的头顶，凭空升起一阵小旋风，这阵风带着铁盆里的纸灰一卷之下，也顺着我家的窗户飞了出去。
我爸妈看了看被烟雾包裹的老头身体，又看了看飞入空中的纸灰，互相对视了一眼，都各自从对方眼中看到了震惊之色。
他们终于看出门道来了，这老头与那穷鬼一样卷着纸灰飞走，穷鬼卷走的是钱，想必老头卷走的定是轿子和四名轿夫了。
在联想到，老头之前说纸人纸轿是他自己用的，看来，他与那穷鬼一样，也变成鬼了，而那轿子就是他的交通工具，是用来接我魂魄回家的。
我爸妈看了看盘坐在地，悄无声息，好像死人一样的蒋老头，目光之中全是敬佩之色，灵魂出窍，说走就走，这得需要多大的道行才能办得到。
随后他二人又猛然想起老头临走之前所说，这二十七根檀香不可灭掉，赶紧瞪着眼睛死死的盯着瓷碗里的檀香，生怕其无故灭掉。
要是灭掉话，他们就赶紧以最快的速度换上一根，以免出现什么不测。
与此的同一时间，躺在炕上昏迷不醒的我，做了一个非常奇怪，而又很漫长的梦。
梦里，天地之间黑漆漆的一片，我感觉自己不知疲惫的一直在向前走。
一会儿翻过一座高山，一会儿穿过一条大河，就这样也不知走了多久，前方终于出现了一条笔直大路。
这条路全是黄色泥土铺成，一眼望不到尽头，我独自一人走在宽阔的黄土路上，周围寂静无声，死气沉沉的。
此时我心里不免有些奇怪了，我怎么会跑到这条黄土路上来，而且这条路如此的陌生，我左思右想，也不记得村子周围哪有这条路，显然，这条黄土路我从来没有走过。
我四周打量了几眼，都是漆黑的一片，阴森森的，看来，眼下也只有这一条路可走，如果我要想回家，也只有埋头一路走到黑了。
想到这里，我迈开步子，顺着黄土路一直向前走了下去。
就这样，也不知我走了多久，我忽然看见前方出现了微弱的灯光，隐隐还有人影走动，当即，我面色为之一喜，心想终于见到活人了，就连忙顺着灯光追了上去。
等我跟着灯光追上人群，发现走在最前方的，是两个身穿古代衙役衣服的人，二人的胸前分别绣着一个大大的“差”字，而我看到的灯光，就是从他们手里提着的白灯笼发出来的。
在他二人身后，跟着大约有四五十人左右，并且这些人都有条不紊的排着队，身上的穿着也非常怪异，有古代的，有现代的。
他们之中有男有女，有老有少，全部低着头赶路，彼此没有一点的交谈。
当时我也没有多想，快步上前拉住一个闷头赶路妇人的手臂，就问道：“大娘，我迷路了，你知道大柳村怎么走吗？”
这名妇女原本低着头，被我这一拉之下，停下身子缓缓的抬起了头，当看到她的面孔，可着实把我吓了一跳，心里顿时咯噔一下。

这名妇人披头散发，脸上没有一点的血色，惨白如纸，并且目光发直，脸上肌肉僵硬，没有丝毫的表情，一副死气沉沉的模样。
这还不算，更令我吃惊的是，之前我没仔细看她的穿着，这一看不要紧，险些吓得我叫出声来，她穿的是一身黑衣服，在胸前竟然还绣着一个大大的“寿”字！
看到这，我哪会不明白呀，这妇人，他娘的穿的竟然是寿衣！
我当即头皮一阵发麻，这女的有病吧，好端端的穿寿衣干什么，这他娘的可是给死人穿的衣服！
正当我震惊之时，妇女声音嘶哑的对我开口道：“大柳村？我不知道，在向前走不远就是鬼门关了，你可以到哪里去问问。”说完，妇女机械似的移动脚步，目光呆滞的跟着人群，缓缓的向前方走去。
“鬼门关！”
我听完心脏如同被提到了嗓子眼，心中开始隐隐感觉到有些不对劲，这鬼门关不正是去往地府的关口吗？我怎么会跑到这种地方来了，难道眼前的这些人都是死人不成。
想到这里，当下我就心里咯噔一下，知道自己是遇上什么脏东西了，要么就是撞进什么邪门的地方来了。
这时我又细看了看那些闷头赶路的人，豁然发现有几个人竟然没有脑袋，还有几个人眼睛高高鼓起，舌头吐得老长，当下我双腿一软，差点一屁股坐在了地上。

content_en:
At this time, my parents felt that a small whirlwind suddenly rose from the top of the old man's head. This gust of wind swept up the paper ash in the iron basin and flew out through the window of my house.
My parents looked at the old man's body wrapped in smoke, then at the paper ash flying into the air, and looked at each other, each seeing shock in the other's eyes.
They finally saw the door. The old man and the poor ghost flew away with paper ashes. The poor ghost took away money, and the old man must have taken away the sedan and the four bearers.
After thinking about it, the old man said before that the paper man and the paper sedan were for his own use. It seemed that he, like the poor ghost, had also become a ghost, and the sedan was his transportation, used to take my soul home.
My parents looked at the old man Jiang who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, silent and dead, with admiration in their eyes. His soul was out of his body and he could leave at will. It takes a lot of spiritual practice to do this.
Then the two of them suddenly remembered what the old man said before leaving, that these twenty-seven sticks of sandalwood should not be destroyed, and they quickly stared at the sandalwood in the porcelain bowl, for fear that it would be destroyed for no reason.
If it goes out, they will quickly replace it with another one as quickly as possible to avoid any accidents.
At the same time, lying unconscious on the kang, I had a very strange and long dream.
In the dream, there was darkness between heaven and earth, and I felt like I was moving forward tirelessly.
Sometimes we climbed over a high mountain, and sometimes we crossed a big river. We walked like this for an unknown amount of time, and finally a straight road appeared in front of us.
This road was completely paved with yellow soil, and there was no end as far as the eye could see. I was walking alone on the wide loess road, and the surroundings were silent and lifeless.
At this time, I couldn't help but feel a little strange, how could I end up on this loess road, and this road was so unfamiliar. I thought about it, but I couldn't remember where there was such a road around the village. Obviously, I had never walked on this loess road.
I looked around for a few times, and it was all dark and gloomy. It seemed that there was only one way to go now. If I wanted to go home, I had to bury my head all the way until it was dark.
Thinking of this, I took steps and walked forward along the loess road.
Just like that, I don't know how long I walked, but I suddenly saw a faint light in front of me, and there were faint figures of people moving around. Immediately, I looked overjoyed, thinking that I finally saw a living person, so I quickly followed the light and chased after him.
When I followed the light and caught up with the crowd, I found that walking in the front were two people wearing ancient government officials' clothes. Each of them had a large word "cha" embroidered on their chests, and the light I saw came from the white lanterns they were holding.
Behind the two of them, there were about forty or fifty people, and these people lined up in an orderly manner. They were also wearing very weird clothes, some ancient and some modern.
There were men and women, old and young among them, all hurried on with their heads lowered, not talking to each other at all.
I didn't think much about it at the time. I quickly stepped forward and took the arm of a busy woman walking on the road, and asked, "Mom, I'm lost. Do you know how to get to Daliu Village?"
This woman had her head lowered, but when I pulled her, she stopped and slowly raised her head. When I saw her face, I was really shocked, and my heart suddenly skipped a beat.
This woman's hair was disheveled, and her face had no color at all. She was as pale as paper, and her eyes were straight. The muscles on her face were stiff, without any expression, and she looked lifeless.
Not to mention that, what surprised me even more was that I hadn’t looked at what she was wearing carefully before. It didn’t matter, I almost screamed out of fright. She was wearing black clothes, and there was a big word "Longevity" embroidered on her chest!
Seeing this, how could I not understand? This womanMan, he's wearing a shroud!
My scalp immediately became numb. This woman must be sick. Why is she wearing a shroud so well? These damn clothes are for the dead!
Just when I was shocked, the woman said to me in a hoarse voice: "Daliu Village? I don't know. Not far ahead, the gate of hell is closed. You can go and ask." After saying that, the woman moved her steps mechanically, followed the crowd with dull eyes, and walked slowly forward.
"The gate of hell is closed!"
After listening to this, my heart felt like it was lifted into my throat, and I began to feel that something was wrong. Isn't this gate of hell the gateway to the underworld? How could I come to a place like this? Are these people in front of me dead?
Thinking of this, my heart skipped a beat, and I knew that I had encountered something dirty, or that I had run into some evil place.
At this time, I took a closer look at the people who were busy walking, and suddenly I found that a few people had no heads, and a few people had bulging eyes and long tongues. At that moment, my legs went weak and I almost sat down on the ground.
